headline: ICAR Emergency Alert: Severe Early Blight & Target-Board Lesion Surge in Nightshade Belts
summary: State agriculture surveillance stations report a 40% surge in Alternaria solani concentric ring foliar necrosis across Solanaceae crops following prolonged morning dew (RH > 88%) and 18-24°C night temperatures. Pathogen sporulation is aggressively spreading through lower senescing foliage.
mandatory_advisory: Enforce immediate prophylactic copper octanoate (FRAC M01) spray before rain events. Prune lower canopy leaves up to 30 cm and transition strictly to drip irrigation.
source: ICAR Central Potato & Horticultural Research Directorate (Nov 2026 Bulletin)

headline: Special Agro-Advisory: Yellow Rust Incursion in Foothill Plains
summary: Puccinia striiformis urediniospore pustules detected on susceptible wheat cultivars in the sub-montane zone. Cold persistent fog is favoring accelerated latent-to-sporulating transitions.
mandatory_advisory: Conduct strip surveys at 5-day intervals. Spot application of propiconazole (FRAC 3) recommended upon first pustule detection.
source: ICAR Indian Institute of Wheat & Barley Research (IIWBR Karnal)

headline: Phytosanitary Quarantine Notice: ToBRFV Mechanical Transmission Protocol
summary: Enhanced greenhouse hygiene measures enforced for seed imports to intercept tobamovirus outbreaks exhibiting mosaic patterns and rugose fruit deformation.
mandatory_advisory: 10% trisodium phosphate (TSP) boot dips and strict disinfestation of pruning shears between plants.
